title: Art Movements and Your Own Project
subject: arts

sections.body: Art reflects its time and place. IMPRESSIONISM (1870s France) captured light and moments with quick brushstrokes. CUBISM (early 1900s) showed objects from several angles at once.
Around the world: Mughal miniature painting (India), Ukiyo-e prints (Japan), the Harlem Renaissance (USA, 1920s) and Mexican muralism (1920s) all responded to their societies.
Your project: choose a medium (drawing, music, film, design), set a goal, make drafts, ask for feedback, and improve. Share your process, not just the final piece.

quiz.q: Which movement showed objects from several angles at once?
hints: The name hints at a geometric shape.
Impressionism was about light and moments. Which name suggests geometric shapes?
quiz.explain: Cubism showed objects from several viewpoints at once.

quiz.q: Why ask for feedback on a draft?
options: It helps you see how to improve
It means your work is bad
hints: Drafts are meant to be improved.
Writers have editors and athletes have coaches. Why?
quiz.explain: Feedback shows you what works and what to improve.
